question: Origin and significance of three bytes at COMMAND.COM offsets 0x1c2–0x1c4
observations: Target bytes immediately follow a three-byte unconditional near jump; the nearby original DOS 6.0 and Astro STUB sources end after this jump.
The bytes appear at linked EXE offset 0x4c2 before the RELOC post-processing step, because the present STUB explicitly emits them.
Target and linked artifact have the same nearby bytes; this does not prove historical source ownership or semantic meaning.
The three checked DOS 6 source variants do not contain the present declaration.
decision: Do not invent an explanation or claim that the source reconstructs historical ownership. Keep the issue open under the no-target-binary-fragment build rule.
limitations: An unconditional predecessor does not establish that no other indirect transfer can enter the bytes; linker history and original 6.20 source are unknown.
